articles.title: EU chief backs plan for Canada to become 'associate member'
articles.description: Canada is seeking closer ties with EU after a breakdown in relations with the US and its president Donald Trump.
articles.titleJa: EU首脳、カナダの「準加盟国」化計画を支持
articles.summary: 米国との関係悪化を受け、カナダがEUとの関係強化を模索。EU首脳が準加盟国化計画を支持した。

articles.title: OpenAI boss says world 'right to be afraid' but should trust AI firms
articles.description: Sam Altman and other tech CEOs say there are incentives to limit advancements in AI, as fears grow over the threats it poses to humanity.
articles.titleJa: OpenAIのトップ、世界は「恐れるのは当然」だがAI企業を信頼すべきだと発言
articles.summary: サム・アルトマン氏らテックCEOが、AIの脅威への懸念が高まる中、AI開発の制限にインセンティブがあると述べ、信頼を訴えた。

articles.title: All support acts on Ed Sheeran's US tour quit after Macklemore dropped
articles.description: The star said he was not responsible for Macklemore being dropped from the line-up after he made pro-Palestinian statements on stage.
articles.titleJa: エド・シーランの米国ツアー、マックルモア降板で全てのサポートアクトが降板
articles.summary: エド・シーランの米国ツアーで、親パレスチナ発言によりマックルモアが降板後、全てのサポートアクトが辞退した。

articles.title: Eight children among 21 killed after war-damaged Gaza building collapses, rescuers say
articles.description: Dozens of people are missing beneath the rubble of a building hit by an Israeli strike last year, where some 10 families had been living.
articles.titleJa: ガザで戦争被害の建物が崩壊し、子供8人を含む21人死亡と救助隊が発表
articles.summary: 昨年イスラエル軍の攻撃を受けたガザの建物が崩壊し、子供8人を含む21人が死亡、数十人が行方不明となっている。

articles.title: Iran war has led to US munitions shortfalls, Pentagon inspector confirms
articles.description: The inspector also found a bottleneck in resupply, despite President Donald Trump's claims that US supplies are "virtually limitless".
articles.titleJa: イラン戦争により米国の弾薬が不足、国防総省監査官が確認
articles.summary: 国防総省監査官が、イラン戦争により米国の弾薬が不足し、補給に滞りがあると確認。トランプ大統領の主張と矛盾している。

articles.title: Saudi Arabia says it shot down Houthi drone south of Mecca
articles.description: The Houthis deny targeting the Islamic holy city after the Saudi-led coalition in Yemen accuses them of a "disgraceful act".
articles.titleJa: サウジアラビア、メッカ南方でフーシ派ドローンを撃墜と発表
articles.summary: サウジアラビアがメッカ南方でフーシ派ドローンを撃墜したと発表したが、フーシ派は聖都を標的にしたことを否定した。

articles.title: Journalist and pilot among three killed after news helicopter crashes in LA
articles.description: The NBCLA news helicopter was flying near the scene of a fatal bus crash.
articles.titleJa: LAで報道ヘリが墜落、ジャーナリストとパイロット含む3人死亡
articles.summary: ロサンゼルスで報道ヘリが墜落し、ジャーナリストとパイロットを含む3人が死亡。致命的なバス事故現場近くを飛行中だった。

articles.title: South African president vows justice as more women's bodies found near Johannesburg
articles.description: Police have not linked the deaths to a serial killer but are investigating this possibility.
articles.titleJa: ヨハネスブルグ近郊で女性の遺体複数発見、南アフリカ大統領が正義を誓う
articles.summary: ヨハネスブルグ近郊で女性の遺体が複数発見され、南アフリカ大統領が正義を誓った。警察は連続殺人犯の可能性も調査中。

articles.title: US limits visas for South African officials over alleged anti-white discrimination
articles.description: Secretary of State Marco Rubio says South Africa has not addressed US concerns over racial inequality.
articles.titleJa: 米国、反白人差別疑惑で南アフリカ政府関係者のビザを制限
articles.summary: 米国は、南アフリカの反白人差別疑惑と人種的不平等の懸念が対処されていないとして、同国政府関係者のビザを制限した。

articles.title: Philippines' Duterte seen in person at International Criminal Court for first time
articles.description: He is due to be tried for crimes against humanity over thousands of deaths linked to his war on drugs.
articles.titleJa: フィリピンのドゥテルテ氏、国際刑事裁判所に初出廷
articles.summary: フィリピンのドゥテルテ元大統領が、麻薬戦争に関連する人道に対する罪で国際刑事裁判所に初出廷した。

articles.title: Gaza: 20 dead, including children, in building collapse
articles.description: The search for survivors has been hampered by Israeli restrictions on heavy machinery in the Gaza Strip. Authorities say 2,000 damaged buildings in the territory are occupied by families who have nowhere else to go.
articles.titleJa: ガザ地区：建物倒壊で子ども含む20人死亡
articles.summary: ガザ地区で建物が倒壊し、子どもを含む20人が死亡。イスラエルの重機搬入制限が捜索を妨げ、2,000棟の被災建築物に住民が居住。

articles.title: How the Houthis are also putting Egypt under pressure
articles.description: The Houthis, a Yemeni rebel group, are expanding their control of maritime corridors in the Red Sea area. Their target is their avowed enemy Saudi Arabia. But the military moves also endanger Egypt.
articles.titleJa: フーシ派がエジプトにも圧力をかける方法
articles.summary: イエメンのフーシ派が紅海海域の海上回廊を支配拡大。敵国サウジアラビアが標的だが、この軍事行動はエジプトをも危険に晒している。

articles.title: Iran: Activists sound alarm as regime seizes Baha'i assets
articles.description: Rights groups warn Iran is increasingly confiscating assets from government critics and members of the country's Baha'i faith, but also actors, athletes and journalists living abroad.
articles.titleJa: イラン：体制がバハイ教徒の資産没収、活動家が警鐘
articles.summary: イラン当局が政府批判者やバハイ教徒、国外居住の著名人の資産没収を強化しており、人権団体が警鐘を鳴らしている。

articles.title: Poland reaffirms support for Ukraine after drone strikes
articles.description: After Russia's recent drone attacks on targets close to the Ukraine-Poland border, Warsaw has doubled down on its support for Kyiv and pledged a "nonprovocative but serious response" to Moscow.
articles.titleJa: ポーランド、ドローン攻撃後もウクライナへの支持を再確認
articles.summary: ロシアのドローン攻撃がウクライナ・ポーランド国境近くの標的に行われた後、ポーランドはキエフへの支持を再確認し、モスクワに「非挑発的だが真剣な対応」を約束した。

articles.title: Belarus to release 25 more prisoners as US eases sanctions
articles.description: Belarus will release 25 more prisoners under an interim agreement with the United States, while Washington plans to lift sanctions on two Belarusian companies and pursue broader negotiations.
articles.titleJa: ベラルーシ、米国が制裁緩和で25人の囚人を釈放へ
articles.summary: ベラルーシは米国との暫定合意に基づき25人の囚人を釈放する。米国はベラルーシ企業2社への制裁を解除し、幅広い交渉を進める予定。

articles.title: Congo's Ebola epidemic may have gone undetected for months
articles.description: The deadliest Ebola outbreak on record in the Democratic Republic of Congo may have begun months before it was first declared in May.
articles.titleJa: コンゴのエボラ流行、数カ月間未検出だった可能性
articles.summary: コンゴ民主共和国での史上最悪のエボラ出血熱流行は、5月に初めて宣言される数カ月前から始まっていた可能性が指摘されている。

articles.title: India news: US bill sanctioning Russia could hit India with tariffs of up to 100%
articles.description: A new bill could give President Trump the power to impose tariffs of up to 100% on countries buying Russian oil and gas, potentially affecting major importer India.
articles.titleJa: インドニュース：ロシア制裁の米国法案、インドに最大100%の関税影響か
articles.summary: ロシア産石油・ガス購入国に最大100%の関税を課す米国新法案が、主要輸入国であるインドに大きな影響を与える可能性がある。

articles.title: Germany news: Conservative state premiers rally behind Merz
articles.description: All eight CDU state premiers have backed Friedrich Merz, urging the party to focus on rebuilding trust. Plus, Germany's coalition is weighing rapid relief as record fuel prices pile pressure on households. DW has more.
articles.titleJa: ドイツニュース：保守州首相がメルツ氏を支持
articles.summary: ドイツの保守派州首相全員がフリードリヒ・メルツ氏を支持し、信頼回復を訴えた。連立政権は燃料価格高騰で家計への迅速な支援を検討中。

articles.title: Duterte makes first appearance before ICC judges
articles.description: Former Philippine President Rodrigo Duterte appeared in person at the ICC as judges considered claims of memory impairment and poor health. The 81-year-old is accused of crimes against humanity.
articles.titleJa: ドゥテルテ氏、ICC判事の前に初出廷
articles.summary: フィリピンのロドリゴ・ドゥテルテ前大統領が国際刑事裁判所（ICC）に初出廷。判事は彼の記憶障害や健康状態の訴えを検討。同氏は人道に対する罪で告発されている。

articles.title: Germany's Chancellor Merz fighting for political survival
articles.description: Following the CDU's crushing defeat in the Saxony-Anhalt state election, many are expressing doubts about their party leader, Chancellor Friedrich Merz. But they don't appear to have any viable alternative.
articles.titleJa: ドイツのメルツ首相、政治的存続をかけて戦う
articles.summary: ザクセン＝アンハルト州選挙での惨敗後、多くの人々が党首フリードリヒ・メルツ首相に疑念を抱いているが、代わる有力な選択肢はない模様。

articles.title: US to bar some South Africans over claims of anti-white discrimination
articles.description:
Announcement of visa restrictions follows Trump’s false claims of ‘white genocide’ taking place in South Africa
The US has announced visa restrictions on some South Africans as Donald Trump’s administration continues to claim that South Africa’s government racially discriminates against white minority Afrikaners.
The announcement did not specify individuals who were barred from the US. Trump has spent his second term falsely claiming there is a “white genocide” in South Africa and railing against its affirmative action policies.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: 米国、反白人差別を主張し一部南アフリカ人の入国を禁止へ
articles.summary: 米国が、南アフリカ政府による白人系アフリカーナーへの人種差別を主張し、一部の南アフリカ人に対するビザ制限を発表。トランプ政権は「白人虐殺」の虚偽主張を繰り返し、アファーマティブ・アクション政策を批判している。対象者は明示されていない。

articles.title: ‘We are prey’: discovery of seven women’s bodies fuels anger over femicide in South Africa
articles.description:
String of female murder victims found near Johannesburg’s international airport, including five in the past week
The discovery of the bodies of seven women around Johannesburg’s international airport, including five in the past week, has prompted an outpouring of fear, grief and anger over a lack of progress in tackling femicide.
When Elizabeth “Tsontso” Moselakgomo did not return after going for a run on 9 September, her eight-year-old daughter alerted relatives, who contacted police. The 38-year-old’s body was found on Saturday and identified by relatives on Monday. The news of her disappearance had gone viral.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: 「私たちは獲物」：南アフリカで7人の女性の遺体発見、女性殺害への怒り高まる
articles.summary: ヨハネスブルグ国際空港周辺で7人の女性の遺体（過去1週間で5体）が発見され、フェミサイド（女性殺害）への恐怖、悲しみ、怒りが噴出。対策の進展不足が批判され、エリザベス・モセラカゴモさんの事件が社会的な関心を集めている。

articles.title: Al-Qaida and IS-linked violence in Africa’s Sahel belt set to hit record levels this year
articles.description:
Twenty-five years after 9/11, figures compiled by conflict monitor underline how Sahel region has become centre of Islamist terror
Islamist extremist violence in Africa’s Sahel region is set to reach historic highs after a series of sweeping offensives by groups linked to al-Qaida and Islamic State, according to new figures compiled by the conflict monitor Acled.
As the US marks the 25th anniversary of the 9/11 attacks launched by al-Qaida against targets in Washington and New York, the statistics underline the continued expansion of the veteran organisation in parts of Africa – in stark contrast with its relative weakness elsewhere.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: アフリカのサヘル地域におけるアルカイダとIS関連の暴力、今年記録的レベルに達する見込み
articles.summary: アフリカのサヘル地域で、アルカイダやイスラム国に関連する過激派組織による暴力が記録的な高水準に達する見込み。9.11テロから25年を迎える中、この地域でのテロ組織の継続的な拡大がデータにより浮き彫りにされている。

articles.title: Slave-trade wealth was embedded in Britain’s financial system, research finds
articles.description:
Dozens of Bank of England directors and founding subscribers invested in trafficking of enslaved Africans
The Bank of England and the British financial system were for centuries deeply involved in the enslavement and transatlantic trafficking of millions of African people, according to new research on Britain’s slavery history.
Research by historians compiling the Register of British Slave Traders has found that the scale of the financial system’s involvement in enslavement is greater than previously known or acknowledged. The Bank of England, the central bank owned by the government since nationalisation by Clement Attlee’s Labour administration in 1946, had dozens of financiers involved in its foundation who were also significant investors in the transatlantic trafficking of enslaved Africans.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: 奴隷貿易による富が英国の金融システムに組み込まれていたことが研究で判明
articles.summary: 新たな研究により、英国の金融システム、特にイングランド銀行が長年にわたり奴隷化と大西洋奴隷貿易に深く関わっていたことが判明。同行の創設に関わった数十人の金融家が、奴隷化されたアフリカ人の人身売買に多大な投資を行っていた。

articles.title: ‘I believed the hype’: the white South Africans denied refugee status in the US
articles.description:
Drive to save thousands of Afrikaners from false claims of ‘white genocide’ appears to show signs of slowing
When Donald Trump announced in February 2025 that the US would accept Afrikaners from South Africa as refugees, many white South Africans who believed that they were victims of racism in their country thought that their prayers had been answered.
However, in the past few months, dozens of applicants to the refugee programme have been rejected, with many left dismayed and confused as to why they would be left to face what Trump has falsely claimed is a “white genocide” in South Africa.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: 「誇大広告を信じた」：米国で難民申請を却下された白人系南アフリカ人たち
articles.summary: ドナルド・トランプが白人系南アフリカ人の難民受け入れを発表したにもかかわらず、多くの申請者が米国で却下された。彼らは南アフリカでの人種差別被害を信じていたが、難民認定されず、「白人虐殺」という虚偽の主張に直面する不安を抱えている。

articles.title: Battle of Chile director Patricio Guzmán dies aged 85
articles.description:
Passionate documentary maker  won international acclaim for unsparing but poetic films exploring the impact of the Pinochet regime in Chile 
Patricio Guzmán, the film-maker who chronicled Chile’s bloody 1970s political strife and its subsequent social and political turmoil in films such as The Battle of Chile and Nostalgia for the Light, has died aged 85. According to Chilean news outlet Emol, Guzmán died on Tuesday in Paris after a cardiorespiratory arrest.
Guzmán’s chief preoccupation throughout his career was the carnage unleashed by Augusto Pinochet’s coup in 1973 against Salvador Allende, Chile’s elected president. He later told the Guardian: “I’m a film-maker who was very marked by the ways of the dictator. It has remained with me for ever. I cannot leave it behind.” However, he resisted the idea that he was an activist, political film-maker, adding: “I’m not a sociologist. Neither am I a politician. I make films that are metaphorical and poetic; I interpret reality through my own personal way of looking.”
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: 「チリの闘い」監督パトリシオ・グスマン氏、85歳で死去
articles.summary: チリの1970年代の政治的動乱を記録した映画監督パトリシオ・グスマン氏が85歳で死去。彼の作品は、ピノチェト政権下の出来事を深く探求し、詩的かつ比喩的な手法で国際的な評価を得た。遺作はチリの歴史と社会に多大な影響を与えた。

articles.title: People protecting nature and land set up self-defence units amid threat of murder
articles.description:
Defenders of forests and rivers killed at rate of one every three days in 2025, with 85% of deaths in Latin America
Nature and land defenders were murdered at the rate of one every three days last year, prompting many communities to set up self-defence units, according to the latest annual death toll by the independent watchdog Global Witness.
Organised crime groups or professional killers were implicated in more than a third of the 124 killings of defenders in 2025 as narco-trafficking activities overlapped with intrusions into indigenous territories and environmental crime, such as illegal logging and wildcat gold mining.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: 自然と土地を守る人々、殺害の脅威に直面し自衛隊を結成
articles.summary: 昨年、自然と土地の擁護者が3日に1人の割合で殺害されたため、多くのコミュニティが自衛隊を結成している。2025年の死者の85%はラテンアメリカで、麻薬密売や違法伐採などが先住民の土地への侵入と重なり、組織犯罪グループが殺害に関与している。

articles.title: Ferocious fight among Brazil’s supreme court erupts on eve of presidential election
articles.description:
Scandal explodes as country’s election campaign peaks, with polls suggesting dead heat between candidates
Brazil’s supreme court has been thrust into what experts consider the greatest crisis since the return of democracy in the 1980s, as two rival judges lock horns on the eve of the presidential election with unpredictable consequences for Latin America’s largest democracy.
The politically charged dispute exploded into public view on Tuesday as judges traded insults and accusations during a heated supreme court hearing that was livestreamed into millions of Brazilian homes.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: ブラジル最高裁で大統領選挙前夜に激しい対立が勃発
articles.summary: ブラジルの最高裁で、大統領選挙前夜に判事間の激しい対立が勃発し、1980年代の民主化以来最大の危機に直面。政治的な緊張が高まる中、判事たちが公開聴聞会で互いを非難し合い、その様子が数百万人の国民にライブ配信された。

articles.title: Carney says Canada will pursue ‘unique security and economic alliance’ with EU amid US trade spat
articles.description:
Prime minister speaks of strengthening Canada’s economic and political ties to Europe at Canada Investment Summit
Mark Carney said Canada will pursue a “unique security and economic alliance” with Europe as he positions his country as a base to build in the “new global economic order”.
Speaking to investors, company executives and government ministers at the inaugural Canada Investment Summit on Tuesday, the prime minister pitched Canada as a “safe harbour” and lucrative home for foreign capital as his government looks to reduce its reliance on trade with the United States.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: カーニー氏、米国との貿易摩擦の中、カナダはEUと「独自の安全保障・経済同盟」を追求すると発言
articles.summary: マーク・カーニー氏は、米国との貿易摩擦が続く中、カナダがEUと「独自の安全保障・経済同盟」を追求すると表明。カナダを「新しい世界経済秩序」における構築拠点と位置付け、米国への貿易依存度を減らすため、海外からの投資を呼び込んでいる。

articles.title: Panama canal traffic facing further cuts as drought from El Niño worsens
articles.description:
Planned daily reductions will further choke one of the world’s most important shipping lanes
The Panama canal plans to again cut maritime traffic due to worsening drought caused by the El Niño climate phenomenon, further choking up one of the world’s most important shipping lanes.
The canal handles 5% of global maritime trade and about 40% of US container traffic; it is favoured by shippers because it usually reduces cost and transit times, especially for companies trading between China, Asia and the US.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: エルニーニョによる干ばつ悪化でパナマ運河の通航がさらに削減へ
articles.summary: エルニーニョ現象による干ばつの悪化で、パナマ運河が船舶の通航をさらに削減する計画。これは世界の重要な航路の一つを逼迫させ、世界の海上貿易の5%、米国のコンテナ輸送量の約40%を担う同運河の機能に深刻な影響を与える見込み。

articles.title: Syria's al-Sharaa opens the biggest Arab Media Summit yet
articles.description: Syria's president delivered the opening keynote in Dubai on Tuesday, a day that also brought the UAE's most complete account of the cyber-attacks it faced this year and new figures on Dubai's media economy.
articles.titleJa: シリアのアルシャラア氏、これまでで最大の「アラブ・メディア・サミット」を開幕
articles.summary: シリア大統領がドバイで開催されたアラブ・メディア・サミットの開会式で基調講演を行い、UAEが直面したサイバー攻撃に関する詳細な報告とドバイのメディア経済に関する新たな数値が発表された。

articles.title: Earning more is not enough: house prices in Spain rise faster than wages
articles.description: Annual pay differs by about €10,000 between Spanish regions, but a 90 m² home can cost up to €383,000 more. In the Balearic Islands and Madrid, buyers need over €129,000 saved for a deposit.
articles.titleJa: 賃上げだけでは不十分：スペインの住宅価格は賃金よりも速く上昇
articles.summary: スペインでは住宅価格が賃金より速く上昇しており、地域差がある中で特にバレアレス諸島やマドリードでは高額な頭金が必要となるなど、住宅取得の困難さが顕著になっている。

articles.title: Tributes paid to Catherine Ringer, singer of Les Rita Mitsouko
articles.description: Catherine Ringer died at 68 from cancer on 14 September. Since then, artists, politicians and cultural figures have paid tribute to the voice and freedom of the music icon.
articles.titleJa: レ・リタ・ミツコ（Les Rita Mitsouko）の歌手、カトリーヌ・リンガーに追悼の意
articles.summary: レ・リタ・ミツコ（Les Rita Mitsouko）の歌手カトリーヌ・リンガーが68歳で癌のため死去。アーティスト、政治家、文化人が彼女の声と音楽の自由を称え、追悼の意を捧げている。

articles.title: Canada in talks to join EU's Erasmus+ exchanges programme
articles.description: Canada is in early talks to join Erasmus+ and possibly Horizon Europe, as Ottawa and Brussels weigh an unprecedented "associate membership" of the EU short of full accession.
articles.titleJa: カナダ、EUのエラスムス+交流プログラムへの参加を協議中
articles.summary: カナダはEUのエラスムス+およびホライズン・ヨーロッパへの参加に向けて初期段階の協議を行っており、ブリュッセルとオタワは完全加盟には至らない「準加盟」の可能性を探っている。

articles.title: 'Starship Troopers' director confirms Donald Trump's space uniforms are Nazi-inspired
articles.description: “I don’t know if this president is aware that the movie says these [characters] are fascists without knowing that they’re fascists. articles.title: World Trade Report: Trade reform to boost growth; inaction can cost 10% global GDP

articles.title: World Trade & Tech Day: AI and trade increasingly intertwined

The event shone a spotlight on how AI and frontier technologies are making international trade more efficient, bringing together government leaders as well as academics and private sector representatives to discuss ways to harness AI's potential into tangible economic gains and an engine for inclusive growth.

articles.title: Russian Federation notifies launch of safeguard investigation on certain flat steel products
articles.description: On 9 September 2026, the Russian Federation notified the WTO’s Committee on Safeguards regarding the initiation on 7 September 2026 of a safeguard investigation on certain flat steel products with polymer coating imported into the customs territory of the Eurasian Economic Union.
articles.titleJa: ロシア連邦、特定のフラット鋼製品に関するセーフガード調査の開始を通知
articles.summary: ロシア連邦が、ユーラシア経済連合に輸入される特定のフラット鋼製品に対するセーフガード調査を開始したことをWTOに通知した。

articles.title: WTO study explores the role of stablecoins in international trade
articles.description: The WTO Secretariat launched a new publication on the role of stablecoins in supporting cross-border trade on 14 September on the sidelines of the WTO's first World Trade and Tech Day. The report, prepared by the Economic Research and Statistics Division and the Trade in Services and Investment Division, examines the opportunities and challenges associated with the use of stablecoins in facilitating international trade, highlighting how they can accelerate cross-border payments and their potential to increase participation in the international trading system, especially for developing economies.
articles.titleJa: WTO、国際貿易におけるステーブルコインの役割に関する研究を発表
articles.summary: WTOがステーブルコインの国際貿易における役割に関する研究報告書を発表。国境を越えた支払いの加速と発展途上国の貿易参加促進の可能性を探る。

articles.title: Goods barometer points to resilient trade growth despite headwinds
articles.description: Global goods trade continued to strengthen in mid-2026 despite persistent geopolitical and policy-related uncertainties, according to the WTO Goods Trade Barometer released on 9 September 2026.
articles.titleJa: 物流バロメーター、逆風にもかかわらず貿易の堅調な成長を示す
articles.summary: WTOの物品貿易バロメーターは、地政学的・政策的不確実性にもかかわらず、2026年半ばのグローバル物品貿易が堅調に推移したことを示した。

articles.title: WTO issues 2026 Annual Report
articles.description: The WTO published today (9 September) its 2026 Annual Report, providing a comprehensive account of the organization’s activities in 2025 and the early part of 2026. The Report looks back at recent key events, such as the 14th Ministerial Conference in March 2026, and describes the WTO's work in addressing the challenges and opportunities facing world trade.
articles.titleJa: WTO、2026年年次報告書を発行
articles.summary: WTOは2026年年次報告書を公表し、2025年および2026年初頭の組織活動、特に第14回閣僚会議について包括的に報告した。

articles.title: New report highlights growth potential of digital trade in Latin America, Caribbean
articles.description: A new report by the WTO Secretariat, the Inter-American Development Bank (IDB) and the World Bank examines how digital trade is transforming the way Latin American and Caribbean (LAC) economies connect to international markets and identifies opportunities to unlock further growth, inclusion and development for the region.
articles.titleJa: 新報告書、ラテンアメリカ・カリブ海地域のデジタル貿易の成長可能性を強調
articles.summary: WTO、米州開発銀行、世界銀行の新たな報告書が、ラテンアメリカ・カリブ海地域におけるデジタル貿易の変革と成長機会を明らかにした。

articles.title: Madagascar Launches Safeguard Investigation on Certain Types of Rice
articles.description: On 2 September 2026, Madagascar notified the WTO’s Committee on Safeguards that it had initiated on 31 August 2026 a safeguard investigation on imports of hulled rice, semi-whitened or whitened rice, polished or glazed, and broken rice.
articles.titleJa: マダガスカル、特定の米に関するセーフガード調査を開始
articles.summary: マダガスカルが、特定の種類の米の輸入に対してセーフガード調査を開始したことをWTOに通知した。

articles.title: Trade finance: how volatile financial conditions influence its availability and impact trade levels
articles.description: Global trade opens opportunities for economic growth. However, moving goods across borders, between exporters and importers, involves counterparty risk such as payment and liquidity risk. Trade finance facilitates trade by mitigating these risks.Using a new dataset, we find that volatile global financial conditions constrict the availability of trade finance, especially in emerging markets and developing countries. In addition, the level of development of local financial markets influences the supply of trade finance by global institutions.
articles.titleJa: 貿易金融：不安定な金融状況がその利用可能性と貿易水準にどう影響するか
articles.summary: 新しい研究によると、不安定な世界の金融状況は貿易金融の利用可能性を制限し、特に新興市場国における貿易水準に影響を及ぼす。
